name: Issues SSO Assertion
description: A Duo SSO application signs users into a service provider or relying party with a SAML assertion or OIDC token — for example Duo SSO as the identity provider an Okta org routes to. The target is deliberately open (omitted): the service provider belongs to another plugin, and no substrate owns a neutral service-provider type yet.

protocol.description: The federation protocol of the Duo SSO application (Duo's sso-generic is SAML, sso-oidc-generic is OIDC).
